- Play strategically with long-term outcomes in mind.
- Observe opponents and adapt.
- Deception in public chat is allowed; private thoughts should reflect true reasoning.
- Be consistent unless there is a reason to change.

I need to sell at least two houses to cover the $34 shortfall. I must distribute the sales evenly across the three light blue avenues.

Selling one house from each property returns $75. This covers the shortfall and leaves one house on each avenue. Selling two from each would remove all buildings.

I should sell the minimum required houses to avoid violating even building rules. Selling only two would be uneven and likely rejected by the engine.

One house on each light blue avenue yields $30, $30, and $40 in rent. This is manageable for p2.

Selling all six houses would give the opponent eight houses. They already have four houses on the orange avenues and two on the reds, so they could build quickly. Keeping one house on each light blue avenue limits their options.

The opponent cannot build more houses on the reds or dark blues without mortgaging properties first. They lack sufficient cash to purchase additional houses.

I will submit a sell_plan to remove one house from each of the three light blue avenues. The engine will apply the sale and update my cash before asking again if I still cannot pay the rent.
